short.pt: Edita uma foto por texto, com até 10 imagens de referência
short.en: Edits a photo from text, with up to 10 reference images

summary.pt: O template oficial `image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit` com o exemplo original: vestir a pessoa da imagem 1 com a camisa da imagem 2 ("Replace costumes for the character"). As imagens de exemplo vêm do repositório Comfy-Org/workflow_templates.
summary.en: The official `image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit` template with the original example: dress the person in image 1 in the shirt from image 2 ("Replace costumes for the character"). Example images come from the Comfy-Org/workflow_templates repository.

what.pt: exemplo original: roupa trocada pela camisa jeans de referência, rosto e pose preservados
what.en: original example: outfit replaced with the reference denim shirt, face and pose kept

summary.pt: **Só pesquisa e avaliação.** Qualquer uso comercial (inclusive assets de produto grátis publicado) exige licença da Alibaba (model-business@notice.qwencloud.com). Ao redistribuir os pesos, manter o aviso de licença.
summary.en: **Research and evaluation only.** Any commercial use (including assets of a free published product) needs a license from Alibaba (model-business@notice.qwencloud.com). Keep the license notice when redistributing the weights.

usage.pt:
1. Imagem a editar no primeiro **LoadImage** (`image_1`); referências nos seguintes, citadas no prompt como `<image1>`, `<image2>`…
2. Imagens de exemplo: [portrait_model_denim.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/portrait_model_denim.png) e [clothing_light_blue_denim_shirt.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/clothing_light_blue_denim_shirt.png) → coloque em `ComfyUI/input/`.
usage.en:
1. Image to edit in the first **LoadImage** (`image_1`); references in the next ones, referred to in the prompt as `<image1>`, `<image2>`…
2. Example images: [portrait_model_denim.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/portrait_model_denim.png) and [clothing_light_blue_denim_shirt.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/clothing_light_blue_denim_shirt.png) → put them in `ComfyUI/input/`.

notes.en: - The optional prompt-rewriting branch (Qwen3.5 9B, off in the template) was removed.
